_about: Which file each feed reads and how to parse it. The connection itself lives in connection_config.json and is referenced by name, so feeds sharing a source do not repeat it. Every feed key here must also exist in destination_config.json.

defaults._about: Merged recursively into each feed, so a feed overriding format.quote_char inherits the rest of format. Anything omitted here falls back to runtime_config.json.
defaults._file_overrides_note: Header and format details can differ between files a single feed matches, so each entry here applies to the files matching its glob. Shape: {"pattern": "*_v2.csv", "header": {...}, "format": {...}, "columns": [...], "primary_key": [...]} - every key except 'pattern' is optional and merges over the feed's own settings. Entries are tested in order and the FIRST match wins, so list the most specific patterns first; a file matching none is read with the feed's settings unchanged. An override carrying 'columns' also replaces the declared schema for those files, which the table schema check then validates against.

dataset1.description: Dataset1.csv in a shared folder, resolved by exact name.

file_daily.description: Date-stamped daily drop, e.g. file20260926.csv, selected by glob.

format._quote_note: This source quotes only its non-numeric field (DDD arrives as 'A'), as a QUOTE_NONNUMERIC-style export does. With the default double quote the apostrophes would be kept and DDD would store the literal 'A'.

file_daily._pk_note: AAA is unique within one drop but repeats across drops, and all drops land in one table. The uniqueness check therefore validates each drop in isolation, not the table as a whole.
